services.name: Inflatable Kayaks & Paddleboards
services.desc: Our self-transport rentals are a flexible, affordable way to enjoy lakes throughout the Black Hills. Pick up your equipment, load up, and head out for a day on the water. Our mix-and-match bundle pricing makes it easy for families and groups to paddle together while keeping pricing simple. Easy to transport, simple to set up, and a great way to try different styles of paddlecraft without needing a trailer or specialized vehicle. We feature gear by Kokopelli & SOL Paddleboards - both Colorado based companies created by paddlers for

variants.label: Expedition-quality inflatable kayaks, paddleboards, and float tubes for rent

blurb: Black Hills Paddlesports offers expedition-quality inflatable kayaks, paddleboards, and float tubes for rent. They provide unique, non-motorized water sport experiences suitable for all ages. Delivery options and on-water support are available to make paddling easy and enjoyable.
extraNote: 525 S. Newton Ave., Hill City, SD, same spot as sister business, a block off Main Street, south of the 1880 Trail, across from Hill City High School, next to the Mickelson Trail - Burlington Northern Trailhead · June 1st through Labor Day
